{"metadata":{"description":"Hermes-style skill self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): crystallizes reusable agent skills from successful turns via signal-triggered LLM review, progressively improves them, and manages everything in a Settings panel.","id":"gh:1353587413","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-skill-evolution","slug":"VanadisGithub/dsh-skill-evolution","topics":["agent-memory","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","self-evolution","skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Hermes-style skill self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): crystallizes reusable agent ski"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lls from successful turns via signal-triggered LLM review, progressively improves them, and manages "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"everything in a Settings panel."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-skill-evolution"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **skill self-evolution plugin** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): it watches agent execution traces and,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" at the end of every successful turn, fires an LLM review when signals trip — distilling workflows w"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"orth reusing into **crystallized skills** registered in the skill catalog. Later runs of the same wo"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"rkflow fold fresh lessons into the existing skill — skills are alive and get better with use."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Event-driven crystallization** — review fires at turn end, not on pure frequency counting; any o"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"f three signals (complex / recovered / repeated) sends the turn to review
- **Strict review gate** —"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" LLM reviewer plus a hard do-not-capture list keeps junk out; `NOTHING_TO_SAVE` is a first-class out"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"come
- **Skills keep evolving** — new evidence is merged into existing skills (version bump); semant"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ic dedup (`FOLD_INTO`) blocks near-duplicates reached through different tool sequences
- **Full mana"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"gement UI in Settings** — tabbed skills/settings views, master switch, skill cards with value/versio"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"n/invocation chips, a tuning pipeline diagram with controls embedded in-place, and editable review p"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"rompts
- **Persistent & self-contained** — skills persist under `generated/` and re-register on rest"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"art; host half depends only on `node:` builtins"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Skills tab** — skill cards with value (high/medium/low), version, invocation count and update-time"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" chips; expand for crystallization signals, tool sequence and the full SKILL.md:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Settings tab** — status overview, review model, generation language and the configuration panels:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Thresholds & controls** — every parameter embedded in the pipeline diagram, editable exactly where"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ntrols** — every parameter embedded in the pipeline diagram, editable exactly where it takes effect:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Signal detection"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"At every turn end (`turn/end`), successful traces meeting a minimum step count are checked against t"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" end (`turn/end`), successful traces meeting a minimum step count are checked against three signals:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Signal | Condition | Meaning |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `complex` | successful turn with ≥ `minToolCalls` tool calls (default 5) | completed a complex tas"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"k |
| `recovered` | had failed steps but the turn still succeeded | hit dead ends and found a workin"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"g path around them |
| `repeated` | same tool sequence recurred ≥ `minPatternOccurrences` times with"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" success rate ≥ `minSuccessRate` | a recurring, proven workflow |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Corroboration gate** (`complexRequiresCorroboration`, on by default): a lone `complex` signal is w"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"eak evidence (any long turn qualifies), so by default it must be corroborated by `recovered` or `rep"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"eated` before review; withheld turns are logged and re-submitted once the sequence later earns a cor"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ew; withheld turns are logged and re-submitted once the sequence later earns a corroborating signal."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Review gate"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The reviewer LLM receives full evidence (signals, user intent, tool sequence, per-step outcomes and "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"summaries) plus the **existing evolved-skill list**, and answers one of: `SAVE` (crystallize a new s"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"kill), `FOLD_INTO` (merge into an existing skill), or `NOTHING_TO_SAVE`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Hard do-not-capture list — the following is **never crystallized**:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- environment-dependent failures (missing binaries, unconfigured credentials, uninstalled packages)
"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"- negative claims about tools ("tool X is broken" would freeze into a long-lived refusal)
- transien"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"t errors cured by a retry (the lesson is the retry pattern, not the original error)
- one-off task n"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"arratives, unresolved failures"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Continuous evolution"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Progressive improvement** — when new evidence lands on an existing skill's sequence (especially "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"error-recovery experience), the reviewer merges the new lessons into the skill body and bumps the ve"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"rsion instead of creating a duplicate
- **Semantic dedup (`FOLD_INTO`)** — the same class of experie"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"nce can reappear via a **different tool sequence**, which pure sequence matching cannot catch. The c"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"rystallization reviewer sees the existing skill list (name + description) and may answer `VERDICT: F"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"OLD_INTO: <existing-skill-name>`; the host then runs the improvement pipeline against that skill"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Output format"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Class-level, kebab-case skills with the standard SKILL.md shape (`# Title / ## When to Use / ## Proc"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"edure / ## Pitfalls / ## Verification`). NAME and section headings are always English; body language"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" follows `skillLanguage`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Option 1: official CLI (once published to npm)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The bundled `dsh.bundle.patch` mounts automatically — no profile edits needed."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Option 2: git clone + link"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Add to `dependencies` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Then run `pnpm install` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web` and hard-refresh the browser."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Option 3: file:// manual mount (prototype debugging)"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Place the repo anywhere (e.g. `~/.dsh/plugins/skill-evolution/`) and append to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch."},{"id":"p35s2","text":" the repo anywhere (e.g. `~/.dsh/plugins/skill-evolution/`) and append to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`?v=N` busts the Node module cache; bump it whenever `plugin.mjs` changes. Host-half changes need a "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"loader patch replay; browser-half changes just need a hard refresh."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"> ⚠️ Pick exactly one option — duplicate mounts cause a dual instance."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Every key below works **both via mount config and directly in the Settings panel** (panel edits pers"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"ist to `runtime-config.json` in the plugin directory, overriding mount config across restarts):"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"| Key | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Data & privacy"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"- Trace evidence lives in memory only (bounded cache), never on disk
- On disk: crystallization arti"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"facts (`generated/*.json`: SKILL.md body, signals, sequences, stats) and `runtime-config.json`
- Rev"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"iew LLM calls go through providers already configured in the deployment — no external endpoints intr"},{"id":"p44s4","text":"oduced
- Uninstalling the plugin removes all data (`generated/` goes with the directory)"}],"truncated":true}
